notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes to Ibn Abi Umayr (rule 11): no saying; the routes are read as the text lists them, with the shared end «جميعا عن محمد بن أبي عمير».
The grouping of «جميعا» (which names meet at أيوب بن نوح, and which route reaches Ibn Abi Umayr directly) is ambiguous; the tool holds the reading.
«رويته عن أبي» names the compiler's father only by relation; the blessing after «محمد بن الحسن» is left out.
